verdict.rationale: Docs mention automating a tailnet via 'infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks, and other integrations,' implying some API-based automation, but the evidence pack contains no explicit citation of a documented public REST API reference, and a probe for standard OpenAPI spec locations returned 404s, suggesting the API isn't easily discoverable/documented at expected endpoints. missing for 10: explicit API reference docs, endpoint/schema documentation, working OpenAPI/swagger spec, examples of programmatic API usage.
